# todo-api-frontend

Generated frontend SDK for `todo-api`.

## Install

```bash
npm install todo-api-frontend
```

## Usage

```ts
import { createApiClient } from 'todo-api-frontend';

const client = createApiClient({
  baseUrl: 'https://api.example.com',
});
```

## Publishing

This package is ready to build and publish, but you should review `package.json` metadata such as the package name, license, and repository fields before publishing your final SDK.
